summary: Constellation Energy Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a secondary offering of 11M shares (plus 1.35M option) by selling shareholders, alongside a $558M share repurchase (2M shares) from the underwriters at the offering price. The company received no proceeds from the offering. The repurchase was executed under an existing buyback program, leaving ~$3.5B remaining authorization. The lock-up on selling shareholders is noted. The deal closed June 2, 2026. Watch for any accelerated buyback activity or insider selling dynamics.
